verdict.rationale:
dlt ships a dbt runner that executes dbt models as a step within the same pipeline run immediately after data is loaded, and a dbt generator that auto-creates staging/fact models from the freshly-loaded schema — both explicitly wired into the pipeline code rather than a separate scheduled job. This directly matches the story of transformations running against fresh data as part of the pipeline flow, not a blind timer.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the dbt runner's post-load triggering behavior, and a concrete end-to-end example showing orchestration ordering (load→dbt run) in production use.
